spec.name: Orange Kitchen Mature Tomato Crop
spec.description: An airy mature tomato crop with delicate branching stems, six stepped leaf sprays, four ripe red tomatoes and one small green fruit. Rooted at y0 with a silhouette contained within x2–14, z2–14 and y0–15.

prompt: Generate an excellent Minecraft Java tomato crop for Orange SMP Kitchen. A mature plant rooted at y0, overall x2..14 z2..14 y0..15. Delicate squared green stems with branches, several irregular stepped leaf clusters with serrated voxel silhouettes, 4-5 ripe red tomatoes with stepped round shape, tiny green calyx, one small unripe green tomato. Plant should have airy gaps instead of a solid bush. Hand-painted vanilla pixel leaf veins and clustered light/dark greens; tomato highlights connected red shading. 35-60 cuboids, ONE 64x64 texture atlas, properly mapped per-face painting. No pot, dirt cube, background or scenery. This is a planted crop, visible at Minecraft scale.
